context: Riku tells Aoi about a castle trip.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (テーブル/ボタン/タクシー/城/シーズン) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家族で、古いお城に行ったよ!
lines.en: My family went to an old castle!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、シーズンだから混んでた?
lines.en: Nice, was it crowded since it's the season?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、観光シーズンで人が多かった。
lines.en: Yeah, lots of people in tourist season.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: どうやって、お城まで行ったの?
lines.en: How did you get to the castle?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: タクシーで、坂を上ったんだ。
lines.en: We took a taxi up the slope.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Did you go into the castle cafe?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 窓際のテーブルで、ジュース飲んだよ。
lines.en: I drank juice at a window table.
lines.style: happy teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: シーズンのお城、写真見せてね!
